summary: 1-8 원본 공개 글을 새 게시글로 복사하면서 새 id/작성자를 쓰고 선택한 경우에만 tag 연결을 복사한다.

brief.purpose: 1-8 원본 공개 글을 새 게시글로 복사하면서 새 id/작성자를 쓰고 선택한 경우에만 tag 연결을 복사한다.
brief.task: post2를 title [복사실습] JPA 복습으로 복사해 copyTags true/false 결과를 비교하고 원본의 소유자·내용·태그가 그대로인지 확인한다.
preconditions: tok-kimjava로 일반 dev board에 작성 가능함을 확인하고 생성 전 post count와 source fields를 기록한다.

scenario.start: post2 original owner/content/tags and post/tag relation counts를 기록한다.
scenario.action: POST /api/posts/2/copies?copyTags=true with title [복사실습] JPA 복습, 이어 copyTags=false로 두 번째 복사한다.
scenario.result: 각 성공 201+Location 새 id; true copy는 tags [spring,jpa], false copy는 tags []; 새 글 author는 Kim, original fields unchanged.
scenario.after: source missing/hidden/deleted/private, invalid copyTags, blank title, unauthorized board permission을 error contract와 no-insert로 확인.

data.name: source post2 fields/status/visibility/author/tags
data.reason: 복사 허용 조건과 원본 불변 비교.

data.name: new post id and Kim author_id
data.reason: 새 리소스가 원본 id/author를 재사용하지 않는지 확인.

data.name: copyTags true/false and post_tag associations
data.reason: 요청 옵션에 따른 연결만 새 글에 포함.

data.name: board write permission and response Location
data.reason: source access와 새 생성 응답 검증.

policies: POST /api/posts/{sourceId}/copies?copyTags=true|false; omitted copyTags defaults false. Body contains title only, 1..200 nonblank after trim.
source must be PUBLISHED+PUBLIC and not deleted; unreadable/missing source 404. Apply target board write permission again; unauthorized 403.
author comes from token. New entity/new id; do not reuse source id or author id. copyTags true shares tag associations; false creates no associations.
Post and post_tag writes are one transaction. Any failure leaves source and new rows unchanged.
inputs: Failure copyTags=maybe, blank/missing title, no token, source ids 6/hidden or 999999; unauthorized board source.
success: 201 with Location /api/posts/{newId}; response title and new id.
true returns spring/jpa tags; false returns empty tags; author is token member2.
Original post2 content, status, owner, id, tags unchanged.

failures.unchanged: post count and post_tag counts unchanged.

failures.when: new author cannot write to source board
failures.unchanged: source unchanged and no target row.

examples.title: Copy tags
examples.start: post2 public, original tags spring/jpa; Kim token
examples.result: 201; distinct new id; author Kim; tags spring/jpa; Location points new id

examples.title: Copy without tags
examples.result: 201; different new id, tags=[]; source still spring/jpa

examples.title: Bad option
examples.result: 400; post count n and source fields unchanged

work: Capture actual created ids from response Location.
Compare source and each copy fields and post_tag joins.
Run failure cases one at a time and check no partial insert.
done: source/new id and author separation confirmed.
400/401/403/404 failures leave source and new-row counts unchanged.
